title.value: Learning to repeatedly solve routing problems
title.justification: This title was chosen as it is the explicit title provided at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Learning to repeatedly solve routing problems

extractions.description: The paper discusses a machine learning-based heuristic for resolving reoptimization problems after minor data changes, focusing on the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) with static clients but variable demands. The method includes learning heuristics for predicting edges in the original solution that remain optimal after demand changes, thereby reducing problem complexity and accelerating solution times.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is on optimization in routing problems using machine learning techniques. While this has implications for improving efficiency, particularly in logistics and transportation, it isn't directly framed within the context of addressing climate change.
climate_change_is_central.quote: In the last years, there has been a great interest in machine-learning-based heuristics for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems. The developed methods have shown potential on many optimization problems.

primary_category.justification: While not directly focused on climate change, the described approach to improving routing efficiency has implications for reducing energy use and emissions in transportation networks, thus aligning it with Climate Change Mitigation strategies.
primary_category.quote: The goal of this paper is to propose a learned heuristic allowing a fast reoptimization of a CO problem after a slight modification of its data.

secondary_categories.justification: The content of the paper is centered around optimizing computational solutions for routing with a secondary implication for efficiency but does not directly address other climate change areas beyond potential energy use reduction.
secondary_categories.quote: In this paper, we focus on CO applications in which a problem is repeatedly solved, e.g., daily or hourly.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP), which is related to optimizing transportation routes and logistics.
primary_sub_category.quote: The goal of the CVRP is to construct vehicle routes in order to serve geographically-dispersed clients while minimizing the travel costs and respecting vehicle capacity.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No other sub-categories beyond Transportation are explicitly addressed or applicable based on the content of the paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: This paper does not cover additional specific areas beyond the routing problem context for CVRP.

applications.justification: The focus on predicting effective routes in response to demand changes directly relates to optimizing freight logistics and routing.
applications.quote: The goal of the CVRP is to construct vehicle routes in order to serve geographically-dispersed clients while minimizing the travel costs.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories sufficiently cover the aspects discussed, primarily focusing on routing optimization relevant to Climate Change Mitigation under Transportation.
new_primary_category.quote: The paper's focus on routing optimization is adequately classified under the existing framework without needing new categories.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category of Transportation under Climate Change Mitigation already encompasses the core application discussed.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The discussed methodologies align with transportation optimizations, fully fitting existing sub-categories.
